data.one_liner: A zero‑dependency collection of premium Flutter UI widgets and interactions.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 50 ready‑to‑use, high‑performance widgets such as sliders, pickers, navigation components, and animated interactions. All components are built with only core Flutter/Dart libraries and can be copied individually without external dependencies.
use_when: You need high‑quality, ready‑made UI widgets without adding extra packages
You want portable components that work on all Flutter platforms
You prefer zero‑dependency solutions for performance or size reasons
avoid_when: You require a full design system with theming beyond Material defaults
You need code‑generated models or JSON serialization
You rely on third‑party icon or font packages
strengths: Zero external dependencies keep app size low
Components are highly polished with physics‑based animations
Works across all Flutter platforms out of the box
weaknesses: Limited theming/customization compared to full UI kits
May overlap with existing Flutter widgets, requiring careful selection

alternatives.name: animations
